source: ETOPO 2022 v1, 60 arc-second, ice surface (NOAA NCEI)
access: OPeNDAP, every 6th pixel in latitude and longitude (6 arc-minute point samples)
layout: real64 little-endian; land_fraction block then land_height block; longitude varies fastest; latitude south to north; cell centres lon=(i-1/2)*0.5 deg, lat=-90+(j-1/2)*0.5 deg
land_height_units: m, mean of max(z,0) over the cell (ocean counted as 0)
